summary: Utility status service returns before releasing field input
symptom: RAM mode was overworld but movement and nurse navigation were ignored after status application.

unexpected.predicted: A verified status service returns at a clean field-input boundary.
unexpected.actual: The success message remained visibly pending with field mode zero until one acknowledged A released the script.
diff: field_message_box_mode was zero while the retained success page still owned input
waiting frames alone never released the script; one acknowledged A did

authority.oracle: A service mutation is complete only when its RAM result is correct and a subsequent field action is accepted; mode=overworld alone is insufficient.
sources: field message mode and retained printer page

reproduction.command: Run pokecenter_apply_status(0, 'Burn') in disposable_clone, then attempt movement or game_heal_party.
steps: Apply Burn through the mapped utility NPC.
Verify party status changed while field mode already reports zero.
Observe movement blocked until the retained success page receives one A.
reproduction.observed: Both original runs returned mode=overworld but blocked movement and nurse navigation; one A dismissed the retained status-condition page and restored field input.

hypotheses.claim: The Center map path from the utility counter to the nurse is disconnected.
hypotheses.result: falsified: the same path succeeds immediately after acknowledging the pending success page.

hypotheses.claim: Additional unlocked frames release the field script.
hypotheses.result: falsified through 720 waited frames; input remained blocked.

root_cause.claim: The status script sets field mode to zero before its success page is acknowledged, so the old interface returned before the script relinquished input ownership.
evidence: The retained page says the selected Pokémon is now inflicted with a status condition while field mode is zero.
Movement stays blocked across 720 frames and is accepted immediately after one A.
Two fixed-fixture replays apply Burn, dismiss exactly one acknowledged page, then heal successfully.

solution.contract_change: pokecenter_apply_status now requires the verified retained success text, sends exactly one acknowledgement, and returns only at a clean overworld boundary.

targeted_checks.name: status then nurse heal replay
targeted_checks.command: Run pokecenter_apply_status(0, 'Burn') then heal_party() twice in disposable clones.
targeted_checks.evidence: Both runs changed status 0->16->0 and finished at overworld with HP 57/57 and exact PP.

regression_checks.name: full Python suite
regression_checks.evidence: 113 tests passed; one opt-in macOS UI integration test skipped.

replay.expected: Status mutation returns with field input released so nurse healing can immediately execute.
replay.actual: Both runs applied Burn, acknowledged the success page once, navigated to the nurse, and verified status cleared with full HP/PP.

domain_knowledge: The utility status script can display a success page while field mode is already zero.
regression_cases: slateport-center-healed-forward-20260809.ss: apply Burn, acknowledge once, then heal.
tooling_contracts: A mutating service must prove subsequent field-input ownership; overworld/mode-zero classification alone is not a completion boundary.
